img_001.summary: Join the Kid's & Mom Walkathon, a 1KM walk with your mom, on August 2, 2026, at 8:00 AM. The event is free for all, with an entry fee of ₹199/-. Participants will receive a medal, certificate, bibs, pencil box, and refreshment. The walk takes place at Decathlon, Mogappair, Chennai. The event is jointly presented by Sportena and Apollo Hospitals, with Decathlon as the Sports Partner and Akshayakalpa Organic as the Refreshment Partner. For details, contact 87783 94729, 86104 43961, or 93808 69045. Google Pay is available at 87783 94729.
